Technology stocks were sharply higher in afternoon trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding nearly 2.5% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising almost 1.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Five9 ( FIVN ) jumped 16% higher on Wednesday after the cloud software company reported a more than fourfold rise in adjusted Q3 net income and a 30% increase in revenue. It earned $0.18 per share, up from a $0.04 per share profit during the same quarter last year and beating the Capital IQ consensus of $0.09 per share.
In other sector news:
(+) Twilio ( TWLO ) was 33% higher Wednesday afternoon after the cloud communications company reported better-than-expected non-GAAP Q3 net income and revenue and guided for upbeat results for the current quarter. Excluding one-time items, it earned $0.07 per share, reversing an 0.08 per share net loss during the same quarter last year and beating the Capital IQ by $0.05 per share. Revenue rose 68% year over year to $168.9 million, also surpassing the $151.6 million analyst mean. Looking forward, Twilio is projecting Q4 net income and revenue topping Street views by at least $0.01 per share and at least $22 million, respectively.
(-) Match Group ( MTCH ) declined almost 21% at one point on Wednesday. The company forecast revenue of $440 million to $450 million as revenue growth slowed in Q3 compared with growth in Q2. Q3 net income and revenue did top analyst forecasts.
